title: 0073: render-loop correction (fbn) vs Gyroflow-free correction (wp1c)
intro: Both sides start from the same edge-offset repair and correct only inside the gyro-noise bursts. LEFT used two Gyroflow renders to measure the residual; RIGHT measured it directly from the source frames with no rendering (the version that could live inside o4fix). Question: is the right side about as smooth as the left?
left: fbn (render loop, you rated near perfect)

items.name: Late cluster
items.look: Watch around 3.8-4.6 s into the clip (source 135.8-136.6 s, burst ending in a fast turn): the Gyroflow-free probe may miss judder there. The long 141-144.5 s burst (9-12.5 s in) should be at least as good on the right.

items.name: Early powerloop section
items.look: 19.5-22.6 s (5.5-8.6 s in) is where the right side measured weaker; 24.9-26.6 s (10.9-12.6 s in) measured better on the right.

items.name: Clean control
items.look: No correction on either side: should look identical.
